insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited

room_rent.note: Room Rent, Boarding, Nursing Expenses all-inclusive up to 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges all-inclusive up to 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every admissible claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured; Ambulance ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability and HIV/AIDS; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, calculi, varicose veins, hysterectomy, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18; only ectopic pregnancy covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; indicative list of 537+ procedures provided in Annexure III

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under specific exclusions

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs by insured and related complications explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items excluded under Annexure II List I (gloves, masks, etc.)

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, claims cannot be contested except on grounds of established fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions.display: Overseas treatment, domiciliary hospitalisation, organ donor hospitalisation, ART for HIV, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, alternative therapies

optional_riders.note: Only one optional add-on mentioned: waiver of the mandatory 20% co-payment on payment of additional premium
